prev.description: the community anchor at generation g (Identity 5.4)

next.description: the community anchor at generation g + 1

generation.description: int-string: the generation of next, at least 2 (generation 1 is group/<digest>); the domain ends at 2^53 - 1 (Identity 5.4), checked by the verifier

proofValue.description: raw Ed25519 under prev over the canonical (JCS) bytes of body, z-base58btc

successorProofValue.description: raw Ed25519 under next over the same bytes

title: RLTP anchor-rotation@1 (rltp-visibility@0.30)
description: The holder's statement that its community anchor moved from one generation to the next (Network Visibility 6.5, Identity 5.4): signed by both generations. It travels inside anchor-mapping@3 (lineage) and inside the anchor.rotate operation of the personal community's log (Access 5.6); it is never exported beyond those two (RLTP-ACC-5975).
